title: Internet Measurement Research Intern - BGP Research Team
teaser: We are recruiting a Internet Measurement Research Intern to join our BGP Research Team, focusing on analysing large-scale BGP data and developing algorithms to enhance network understanding. Collaborate with experienced researchers and engineers, applying data science and AI/ML techniques. Ideal for candidates with a strong networking background and hands-on experience in network measurement.
description:
Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.

Meet the Team 
We’re the Applied Research team at Cisco ThousandEyes. Our mission is simple but ambitious: use Internet-scale data to build network assurance solutions that help enterprises see, understand, and fix problems across the Internet, cloud, and enterprise networks.  We sit at the intersection of research, data science, AI/ML, and product. That means we don’t just analyze data. We turn ideas into algorithms, prototypes into products, and insights into features that customers rely on when things break at 3am! 

Your Impact 
This internship sits within the BGP research group, where we study how BGP is used in the real world and develop algorithms, analyses, and tools that improve understanding of how networks interconnect and how to better protect this critical Internet infrastructure.  

As an intern, you’ll collaborate closely with experienced researchers, engineers, and product partners. You’ll use statistics, data science, and AI/ML techniques to analyze large-scale BGP data, characterize routing behavior and dynamics, and prototype algorithms that advance understanding of Internet topology and interconnection.  

This internship is designed to be hands-on, impactful, and fast-moving, with a strong emphasis on learning, experimentation, and turning research ideas into practical solutions.  

In addition to influencing production systems, your work will contribute to internal research artifacts, technical reports, and research publications. ThousandEyes BGP Research team frequently presents at leading community and academic venues such as NANOG, RIPE, and IMC 

Minimum Qualifications 

Currently pursuing a graduate degree in Computer Science 

Strong understanding of networking and internet protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, BGP, HTTP, etc.) 

Hands-on experience working with BGP data or routing measurements (e.g., route collectors, MRT data, routing tables, updates) 

Demonstrated portfolio of network measurement work through publications and/or course projects 

Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with data science and data analysis 

Great written, verbal, and persuasive communication skills 

Preferred Qualifications 

Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science 

Track record of publications at academic and/or industry conferences 

Experience applying machine learning and AI methods to networking problems 

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
